scope.changes: Five source dispatch adapters, one borrowed context, documentation and evidence. Existing R35/R33 providers and their guards remain unchanged.
scope.unchanged: Application, GameStartupHost, frame, sound, input, XLive, renderer callbacks, shared deletion layout, clock lifecycle and raw methods.
scope.ownership: No clock allocation, registration, ownership, process binding, synthetic vtable or independently advancing state. std::logic_error is a source failure mechanism and may use the C++ runtime; this is not an allocation-free failure ABI claim.

public_context.lifetime: Borrow the SAME persistent publication cell and method context. Published pointer must designate live, accessible, genuine80h storage; profile table must remain readable through every operation. No storage-size or dangling-pointer validation is claimed.
public_context.capture: Each operation loads current AB0 exactly once into a local pointer. Calls made later independently reload the cell. No universal cached owner.
public_context.identity: Require non-null clock and methods.profile_d68d50; read object profile DWORD and require D68D50; read the selected borrowed slot word and require its exact original target. Never execute that numeric target.
public_context.failure: Null publication/profile, unsupported object profile or target, and null sample output raise std::logic_error at the source boundary. No native fault/FH3/SEH ABI equivalence. Existing R35/R33 failure behavior inside their providers is unchanged.

fixture.profile: Copies freshly PE/live-verified44B D68D50 profile into a reserved numericD60000 band at addressD68D50, protects band read-only. Original words remain data; no original code executes. One negative target mutation is applied under VirtualProtect and restored before drain.

Fixed slot accepts -7 and50 as signedmilliseconds. Expected increment uses existing timestamp arithmetic. Fixed sample copies exactly B current16B with no QPC call and no hidden advance.

Full existing BD0400 shared drain dispatches genuine BEE110 through frame_clock binding, frees each clock exactlyonce through observed real CRTfree, clears AB0, clears manager fields/section, and retains AA0 until caller frees manager.

fixture.instrumentation: QueryPerformanceCounter/free IAT observers forward to the real functions and are restored by scope cleanup. QPF and QPC effects are real; no fake clock, allocator, registration or terminal destructor providers.
fixture.limitations: No new injected QPC/QPF failure matrix; ignored-BOOL/arithmetic/x87 evidence remains R35. This fixture does not prove application startup/shutdown binding, original FH3/SEH, concurrent retirement, worker stop/join, active rendering or gameplay.

linked_source_machine.inspection: MSVC map resolves linked function addresses and source object. Capstone decodes exact PE-backed spans bounded by next mapped function, including possible alignment. Each wrapper has exactly one direct call to its admitted existing source provider. These are source-machine receipts, not game-byte parity.
linked_source_machine.publication_load: Reviewed all five compiled dispatch prefixes: load context argument, load address of AB0 cell, then exactly one publication load (MOV ECX,[EAX] in advance/current/fixed/interval; MOV ESI,[EAX] in sample), followed by null/object/profile-slot checks. Separate helper calls perform fresh loads. Source contains one volatile publication read per dispatch.
